mapper.select: SELECT LOG_ID AS logId, ACTION AS action, DATE_FORMAT(CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S') AS createdAt FROM KIOSK_LOG WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT HOUR(CREATED_AT) AS PRINT_HOUR , COUNT(*) AS PRINTING_COUNT FROM KIOSK_LOG WHERE ACTION='명찰 발급' GROUP BY HOUR(CREATED_AT) ORDER BY PRINT_HOUR
SELECT ACTION , COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM KIOSK_LOG GROUP BY ACTION ORDER BY CNT DESC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ATTENDANCE) AS TOTAL_ATTENDANCE, COUNT(CASE WHEN STATUS = '출석' THEN 1 END) AS ATTEND, COUNT(CASE WHEN STATUS = '지각' THEN 1 END) AS LATE, COUNT(CASE WHEN STATUS = '조퇴' THEN 1 END) AS EARLY_LEAVE, COUNT(CASE WHEN STATUS = '결석' THEN 1 END) AS ABSENCE FROM ATTENDANCE
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KIOSK_OPERATIONAL_LOG WHERE DORM = 'IN' AND DEL_YN = 'N') AS assignCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENTS WHERE DORM_YN='Y' AND DEL_YN = 'N') AS totalStudents

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EDU_INFO WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' AND STR_TO_DATE(START_DATE, '%y%m%d') <= CURDATE() AND STR_TO_DATE(END_DATE, '%y%m%d') >= CURDATE() ) AS ACTIVE_EDU_COUNT,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENTS S JOIN EDU_INFO E ON S.EDU_ID = E.EDU_ID WHERE S.DEL_YN = 'N' AND E.DEL_YN = 'N' AND STR_TO_DATE(E.START_DATE, '%y%m%d') <= CURDATE() AND STR_TO_DATE(E.END_DATE, '%y%m%d') >= CURDATE() ) AS TOTAL_STUDENTS,
(SELECT IFNULL(ROUND( COUNT(CASE WHEN A.STATUS = '출석' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1), 0) FROM ATTENDANCE A JOIN STUDENTS S ON A.STUDENT_ID = S.STUDENT_ID JOIN EDU_INFO E ON S.EDU_ID = E.EDU_ID WHERE A.ATTEND_DATE = CURDATE() AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' AND E.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND STR_TO_DATE(E.START_DATE, '%y%m%d') <= CURDATE() AND STR_TO_DATE(E.END_DATE, '%y%m%d') >= CURDATE() ) AS AVG_ATTEND_RATE,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT E.EDU_ID, COUNT(CASE WHEN A.STATUS = '출석' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(A.ATTENDANCE_ID), 0) AS RATE FROM EDU_INFO E JOIN STUDENTS S ON E.EDU_ID = S.EDU_ID AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' JOIN ATTENDANCE A ON S.STUDENT_ID = A.STUDENT_ID AND A.ATTEND_DATE = CURDATE() AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE E.DEL_YN = 'N' AND STR_TO_DATE(E.START_DATE, '%y%m%d') <= CURDATE() AND STR_TO_DATE(E.END_DATE, '%y%m%d') >= CURDATE() GROUP BY E.EDU_ID HAVING RATE < 80 ) sub) AS WARNING_EDU_COUNT
